idea-plugin.name: Blamely
idea-plugin.description:
Stop guessing your codes origin. Know every human and AI contribution

Blamely brings AI contribution tracking directly into IntelliJ IDEA. As AI-assisted coding becomes the norm, Blamely answers the question every developer and every team is starting to ask: how much of this codebase is actually human?

Blamely sits quietly in your IDE and analyzes your git history commit by commit. It detects which lines were written by AI tools - GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Codeium, Claude, and others - and which were written by hand. The results appear instantly in a clean, native-feeling tool window: no external services, no sign-up, no telemetry.

What Blamely tracks

  • AI / Human line count per commit and per file
  • Which AI models contributed and how much
  • Contribution percentage visualized with inline progress bars
  • Full commit history with diff stats, branch tags, and authorship breakdown

Why developers use Blamely

  • Understand your real contribution before a code review
  • Track how your AI usage evolves over time
  • Make informed decisions about what to refactor or own
  • Satisfy team or company policies around AI-generated code

Blamely doesn't judge. It just shows you the numbers - and lets you decide what they mean.

Because git blame only tells half the story.

Supported AI providers

GitHub Copilot (Chat, Inline, Completion) | Claude (Chat, Inline, Completion) | JetBrains AI

Part of the Blamely open standard - same .git/blamely format for cross-IDE compatibility. Learn more at blamely.ai
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.0.0

  • Intellij 1.0.0 data layout - Primary blame snapshots and per-branch report.yml under ~/.blamely/repos/<stableId>/ (same 8-char repo hash as the Intellij extension); optional migration when legacy .git/blamely contained snapshots/trace-style data
  • Pre-commit hookRunner.js - Bundled Node runner: tries user-layout copy then .git/blamely/hookRunner.js; shows contribution bars from blamely-detector.ai (node on PATH required)
  • blamely-detector.ai - Written under .git/blamely/ after commits with # ai_lines_deleted / human delete totals for hookRunner
  • Repo-local branch sessions - Per-branch state under .git/blamely/<branch>/{open,stash,closed}/; IntelliJ mirrors session metadata under ~/.blamely/intellij/repos/<repoKey>/sessions/<id>/blamely.json (not in the project folder); blame snapshots still readable from old .git/blamely/snapshots/... paths during migration
  • Session paths - getRepoRoot accepts a file or directory; legacy ~/.blamely/session migration unchanged
  • Settings - showGutterDecorations, autoInstallHook, reportOnSave, suggestionTimeout
  • Pre-push - Shell helper still pushes refs/notes/blamely
